name: the live-title flag is stamped on the live rows only, not on their master rows
why: renderGroupedTable() always renders clones of groupedRows. A flag that never reached the master row is gone after the first filter or sort re-render on a multi-table page.

name: the separator warning outranks the error
why: An impossible date written with a plain '-' must show red, not yellow: the error is the more urgent message.

name: near misses are not flagged red
why: A date-led title that is not 'DATE: Venue, City, …' is a data-entry error the cell tint must show.

name: sa_enable_uvd_live_titles no longer gates the sections
why: The setting must drop every 'Live title info' section from the panel.

name: the day check ignores the month's length
why: 29 February 1999 and 31 April do not exist; a flat 1-31 range accepts them.

name: the release/release group link restriction is dropped
why: The live bootleg guideline covers releases and release groups only. A live-shaped title on a recording link must not count.

name: the sub-table's ' release' suffix is not stripped
why: releasegroup-releases names its status sub-tables 'Bootleg release', 'Official release'. Without the strip no status is ever recognized and the Validity entries lose their status.

name: a per-separator facet ignores the separator
why: 'Separator - only' > '✅ valid' must match only valid titles written with a plain '-', not every valid live title.
